title: Build a landing page for my new studio
description: I'm a freelance illustrator launching a studio site and need help building a clean one-page landing page (Next.js or plain HTML/CSS is fine). Looking for someone to pair on layout, responsiveness and a simple contact form.
author: Priya Nair

title: Create pixel-art sprites for my indie game
description: I'm prototyping a 2D farming sim in Godot and need a batch of pixel-art assets — a player character, crops, tools and tileset. Happy to pay a rate, and keen to learn your process while you work.
author: Tane Williams

title: Set up automated tests and a CI pipeline
description: My side project has zero tests and deploys manually. I'd love a session to set up vitest, wire a GitHub Actions CI pipeline and add a basic deploy step — and to understand what's actually worth testing.
author: Sofia Rossi
